finalText:
**Migration finished.** 12 files still used the old call. All 36 sites now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

Two things I left alone on purpose. `cache.query` is the cache, not the database, so all 25 uses stay. `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` keeps its 2 calls, since an upgrade would overwrite edits there.

`node verify.js` passes:

```
OK every db.query call site moved to db.execute, and nothing else moved
```
